Description
S/SM-Series Environmental Chamber product line delivers quality, accuracy, and reliability for your testing program. The efficient refrigeration system provides moderate temperature change rates while allowing the environmental chamber to consume less power than comparable test chambers. From prototyping and durability testing to component reliability screening, a S/SM-Series Environmental Chamber is a cost-effective testing solution for any industry.
